items.title: 8.13 Dabao ya hajm ki tabdeeli ka asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.13, printed pages 180-181.

blocks.text: Hajm ya dabao ki tabdeeli ka koi asar nahi jab system mein gases shamil na hon, ya jab homogeneous gas equilibrium mein gaseous reactants aur products ke moles barabar hon; is par sirf tab bahas ho sakti hai jab reactants aur products ke gaseous moles ghair-barabar hon. Haber synthesis par ghaur karein, N2(g) + 3H2(g) se 2NH3(g). Dabao mein izafa ya hajm mein kami: forward reaction moles aur yun hajm ghatati hai, to equilibrium par mixture shuru se kam hajm leta hai, aur dabao barhane se zyada ammonia banti hai, forward simt mein shift. Dabao mein kami ya hajm mein izafa: reaction us taraf chalti hai jo zyada hajm leti hai, aur ammonia synthesis ulti simt shift hoti hai.

blocks.caption: Dabao aur hajm ki tabdeeliyan (Quick Check 8.6)

blocks.prompt: Kis gaseous equilibrium mein dabao ka position par koi asar nahi: 2NO2 se N2O4; PCl5 se PCl3 + Cl2; CO + H2O se CO2 + H2; 2SO2 + O2 se 2SO3?
blocks.explanation: CO + H2O se CO2 + H2, kyunke har taraf gas ke do moles hain; dabao ya hajm ki tabdeeli dono taraf barabar asar karti hai. Baqi teen gas moles ki tadaad badalte hain aur dabao se shift hote hain.

items: Dabao ya hajm sirf tab aham hai jab gas moles mukhtalif hon: zyada dabao (chhota hajm) kam gas moles wali taraf ko tarjeeh deta hai (ammonia synthesis forward); kam dabao zyada wali ko; position badalti hai, Kc nahi.
